note:
HEARTLAND CO-OP PUBLISHES ITS WHOLE BOARD ON ONE PAGE, AND THIS IS ONE LOCATION ON IT. The page is https://myaccount.heartlandcoop.com/bids.htm, read on 2026-09-14 by scripts/probe.mjs (run 94223494234) with raw=400000. It answered 200, text/html, 50,890 bytes, Apache, and carries four tables -- CORN, PROCESSOR CORN, SOYBEANS, PROCESSOR SOYBEANS -- 129 body rows against five delivery columns each, dated 9/11/26 and headed "Prices are as of close of open outcry @ 1:15 PM". 

locationId IS THE BOARD'S OWN dest-name STRING, VERBATIM AND IN ITS OWN CASE. filterLocation() in lib/parse.mjs compares by exact string equality with no trim and no case fold; anything else here would match zero rows and refuse the source.

HOW THIS PLACE WAS PLACED: data/known-elevators.json, which is the Barchart facility roster: this branch is filed there as "MITCHELLVILLE" in Mitchellville, IA 50169. THAT IS THE WHOLE POINT OF THIS SOURCE -- the roster row it replaces. COORDINATE 41.6609,-93.37 is the centroid of ZIP 50169 from data/zips, which is the TOWN and can be miles from the yard.

WHY identityAlternative. This board prints cash and basis and no futures price, so cash - basis = futures cannot run on it. lib/adapters/heartland.mjs checks two other things instead -- every cell in a column must imply the same futures price to the cent, and that price must sit within 300c of the contract the column heading names -- and stamps every row only after both pass on the whole board. See that file's header.

bands are the DEFAULT_BANDS values from lib/board.mjs for the two grains this board posts. They are sanity floors, not a claim about what this location trades.
publicNote: Heartland Co-op's own closing board, the same page their members read. Cash and basis are their commercial numbers, posted as of the close of open outcry at 1:15 PM. The futures contract is carried only so a consumer can re-check cash minus basis; no futures price is republished from here.
_pending: cashRounding is NOT set and is not measured here, because on this platform it cannot fire: explainedByRounding() in lib/board.mjs only ever runs on rows that carry a quoted future, and these rows carry none by design. If this board ever starts printing a futures column, that is the day to measure it.
